addon.name: Merge Playlist into one Video
addon.summary: Combine the videos and pictures of a playlist into a single video file.
addon.description:
Turns a playlist of videos, pictures and music into one continuous video file that is easy to copy onto a phone, a TV stick or a USB drive.
Everything is joined in the order of the playlist. Pictures are shown for a few seconds each, videos of different shapes and sizes are fitted onto the same screen with black bars, and clips that have no sound stay silent. If your playlist trims a clip so it starts or stops part-way through, those trims are kept.
This add-on needs the free program ffmpeg (ffmpeg.org) to be installed on your computer.
To use it: open your playlist in VLC, then choose View, then Merge Playlist into one Video. Check where the file will be saved, choose the picture size and quality, and press Merge. You can keep using VLC while it works; press Refresh to see how far along it is.
The result is saved as an .mp4 file, which plays on phones, computers and most TVs.
